parsed.explanation: The dossier documents sustained state-tolerated targeting and near-total impunity: an enforced sodomy statute (10 years' hard labour) that police use to harass gay men and trans women, no gender recognition, no anti-discrimination protection, police who fail to investigate or intervene in anti-LGBT violence including murder (the 2013 mob killing of a gender-nonconforming 16-year-old remains unsolved a decade on), documented police torture, vigilante violence celebrated publicly, entrenched hostility in custody (isolation, corrective rape, a 2023 lockup beating), and two decades of overwhelmingly hostile public opinion (~60-96% opposition). Tourist resorts form insulated bubbles, which tempers everyday exposure for short-stay visitors, but once outed the traveller faces societal threat-framing with no functioning recourse — tier 2/3 exposure, not tier 1. Extrapolating from structural signals (criminalisation, denial of recognition, no record of relief, recorded police harassment of trans women), this sits in high risk: slightly above the purely gang-driven anchor because the state itself is an active lever, but below severe-risk profiles since there is no systematic arrest-for-presentation campaign or execution. Thin border/detention-documentation gaps resolve adversely given the surrounding record.
